directive:
MATHEMATICAL CONSULT VERDICT: Do not certify the original all-smoothness same-sample Möbius theorem or the claimed full bank-region extension. The available receipts do not imply either result, and treating Liu’s projection stability or Dobriban’s squared-contrast calculation as transferable would assume the central missing theorem.

Apply the following exact target adjustment.

TARGET def:rank-feasible-handle
TARGET def:rank-stressed-handle
Replace both unresolved handles, for the adjusted validity region R_pair = {0 < α ≤ 1, 0 < β ≤ 1, 0 < γ ≤ 1}, by the same explicit local cross-pair estimator. For h = h_n^*, k = k_n^*, set δ = h k^(-1/d), E_hk = { {i,j} : i < j, X_i,X_j ∈ B_h, ||X_i-X_j||_∞ ≤ δ }, Λ_hk = binom(n,2) h^(2d)/k, D_hk = Σ_{{i,j}∈E_hk} (A_i-A_j)^2, T_hk = Σ_{{i,j}∈E_hk} (A_i-A_j)(Y_i-Y_j), and a_0 = ε(1-ε) f_-^2. If Λ_hk < 1 or D_hk < a_0 Λ_hk, set the raw estimate to 0. Otherwise set it to T_hk/D_hk. In every case define the total estimate by clipping the raw estimate to [-2L,2L]. Set both τhat_n^G and τhat_n^P equal to this estimator on R_pair; no empirical Gram, inverse, Möbius kernel, truncation order, or density estimate is used.

TARGET thm:rank-feasible-local-hoif
Do not prove the present statement. Replace it by the cross-pair risk theorem restricted to compact K ⊂ R_pair. The proof must start from the exact two-point causal identity: for x,z and independent observations conditional on X_i=x,X_j=z,
E[(A_i-A_j)(Y_i-Y_j) | x,z] = (π(x)-π(z))(μ_0(x)-μ_0(z)) + π(x)(1-π(z))τ(x) + π(z)(1-π(x))τ(z),
while E[(A_i-A_j)^2 | x,z] = π(x)(1-π(z)) + π(z)(1-π(x)). For θ = τ(x_0), the conditional mean of (A_i-A_j)(Y_i-Y_j) - θ(A_i-A_j)^2 is therefore bounded on E_hk by C[δ^(α+β) + h^γ]. This is where α,β,γ ≤ 1 is used; do not claim the same bound above order one from first differences.

Prove the geometric occupancy bounds directly from the density band. Each coordinate interval of B_h has length at least h, and δ ≤ h, so P(X_1,X_2 ∈ B_h, ||X_1-X_2||_∞ ≤ δ) ≥ f_-^2 h^d δ^d = f_-^2 h^(2d)/k. Overlap gives E D_hk ≥ 2ε(1-ε) f_-^2 Λ_hk = 2a_0 Λ_hk.

For S_hk = T_hk - θD_hk, use bounded kernels and independence of disjoint pairs. Establish explicitly |E S_hk| ≤ CΛ_hk[h^γ + δ^(α+β)], Var(S_hk) ≤ C[Λ_hk^2/N_n^* + Λ_hk], and Var(D_hk) ≤ C[Λ_hk^2/N_n^* + Λ_hk]. The shared-index term follows from P(edge(1,2), edge(1,3)) ≤ C h^(3d)/k^2; the diagonal term follows from P(edge(1,2)) ≤ C h^(2d)/k.

Chebyshev then gives, when Λ_hk ≥ 1, P(D_hk < a_0Λ_hk) ≤ C[(N_n^*)^(-1) + Λ_hk^(-1)]. On the successful screen divide by a_0Λ_hk; on failure use the clipped 4L loss. Since Λ_hk is comparable to (N_n^*)^2/k, conclude sup_P E|τhat_pair(x_0)-τ_P(x_0)| ≤ C_K[(h_n^*)^γ + {h_n^*/(k_n^*)^(1/d)}^(α+β) + (N_n^*)^(-1/2) + sqrt(k_n^*)/N_n^*] ≤ C_K r_n^*. If Λ_hk < 1, use the 4L bound and sqrt(k_n^*)/N_n^* ≳ 1. Remove every claim that this theorem is a Möbius-stabilized HOIF or holds for arbitrary compact K ⊂ (0,∞)^3.

TARGET oeq:multiresolution-order-frontier
Close only the adjusted first-difference question: the correction order is one, there is one resolution δ = h k^(-1/d), and the signed pair contrast is (1,-1). State explicitly that minimal higher-order projected-tuple correction and the frontier above order one remain open. Take U = {0 < α < β < γ < 1}. This is a nonempty open set outside R_bank because β > α.

TARGET thm:rank-stressed-close-pair
Replace the statement by the preceding C_K r_n^* bound on P_n=1 for compact K ⊂ R_pair. Claim the explicit outside-bank open set U, but delete the assertion that the validity region contains all of R_bank. Do not cite Dobriban’s squared-contrast variance identity as proving the causal result; prove the displayed causal cross-contrast identity and both U-statistic variance components directly.

TARGET def:unified-estimator
Retain the deterministic clipped switch, with both branches instantiated by the explicit cross-pair estimator on R_pair.

TARGET thm:unified-benchmark-attainment
Restrict to compact K ⊂ R_pair. Substitute the branch bound above into the already-proved exhaustive-switch inequality and conclude the unconditional C_K r_n^* bound. Delete the all-smoothness, Möbius-HOIF, full-R_bank-containment, and general KBRW-class attainment language.

Add a separate clearly labeled conditional bracket, not a proved theorem: extension beyond R_pair would require an explicitly specified higher-order random-design contrast or localized Möbius estimator together with a proved uniform L∞ projection bound, causal numerator/denominator expansion, spectral-screen probability, and complete collision/Hoeffding accounting. None may be imported from the current literature receipts without proof.

MAXIMALITY IMPROVEMENT — retain all existing cross-pair definitions and proofs, but add the following consequences and scope corrections.

TARGET def:kbrw-objective
TARGET def:optimizer
Do not alter the objective or optimizer. Add a proved corollary `cor:optimizer-elbow-rate`. Put s=(α+β)/2 and s_0=(d/4)/(1+d/(2γ))=dγ/{2(2γ+d)}. For every fixed positive (α,β,γ), prove by direct minimization of Φ_n, including integer rounding of k and the bounds defining T_n, that r_n^*≍n^{-1/{1+d/(2γ)+d/(4s)}} if s<s_0 and r_n^*≍n^{-1/{2+d/γ}} if s≥s_0. Give feasible tunings h≍n^{-(1/γ)/{1+d/(2γ)+d/(4s)}}, k≍n^{ {d/(2s)-d/γ}/{1+d/(2γ)+d/(4s)} } below the elbow, and h≍n^{-1/(2γ+d)}, k≍nh^d at and above the elbow. Prove matching lower bounds for the infimum rather than merely citing the KBRW tuning heuristic. State that equality belongs to the oracle-rate side and creates no logarithmic factor.

ADD thm:positive-band-oracle-lower-bound
Under exactly P_band, prove inf_{τhat} sup_{P∈P_band} E_P|τhat(x_0)-τ_P(x_0)| ≥ c n^{-γ/(2γ+d)}. Use a self-contained two-point bounded submodel: X uniform on [0,1]^d, π≡1/2, μ_0≡1/2, bounded Bernoulli potential outcomes independent of A given X, and two treated regressions differing by opposite γ-Hölder bumps of bandwidth h at x_0. Choose h≍n^{-1/(2γ+d)}; show target separation ≍h^γ and product-law KL or squared Hellinger distance O(nh^{d+2γ})=O(1). Verify explicitly that uniform density satisfies f_-<1<f_+, overlap holds, potential outcomes are bounded by L≥1, and constant π and μ_0 belong to every required nuisance Hölder ball.

ADD cor:positive-band-high-s-minimax
Combine `cor:optimizer-elbow-rate`, `thm:unified-benchmark-attainment`, and `thm:positive-band-oracle-lower-bound`. For compact K⊂R_pair lying in s≥s_0, conclude that the positive-band minimax mean-absolute risk is n^{-γ/(2γ+d)} up to constants. For s<s_0, state only the proved upper rate n^{-1/{1+d/(2γ)+d/(4s)}} and the oracle lower rate; explicitly leave the positive-band low-smoothness minimax rate unresolved because KBRW’s support-hole fuzzy-hypothesis laws do not satisfy the global positive density lower bound.

ADD prop:cross-pair-saturated-bound
Let ᾱ=α∧1, β̄=β∧1, γ̄=γ∧1. For arbitrary α,β,γ>0, use the already-defined cross-pair estimator and the existing proof verbatim, replacing the three first-difference exponents, to prove sup_{P∈P_band} E_P|τhat_pair_n(x_0)-τ_P(x_0)| ≤ C{h^{γ̄}+(h/k^{1/d})^{ᾱ+β̄}+N^{-1/2}+√k/N} at its stated tuning. Explain that this is a genuine all-smoothness robustness bound for the order-one estimator, but it is not attainment of the unsaturated KBRW objective outside R_pair. Do not broaden the headline theorem beyond R_pair.

TARGET oeq:multiresolution-order-frontier
Rewrite the stale OEQ as a higher-order extension question. Remove the request to find a reversed-order open set U: the proved order-one theorem has already supplied U={0<α<β<γ<1}. Ask instead for an explicit random-design correction exploiting at least one smoothness index above one, with its own new extension set U_HO⊂(0,∞)^3\R_pair, and for any coverage of R_bank\R_pair. Replace the obsolete sentence “the banked first-difference identity works only on β<α” by: “The proved order-one cross-pair identity already handles both nuisance orderings through smoothness one; what remains open is exploiting derivatives above order one and controlling the resulting higher-order random-design normalization and Hoeffding terms.”

TARGET related_work
Replace the KBRW comparison by: “CausalSmith attains the algebraic three-term objective appearing in KBRW on the fixed positive-band class and R_pair. KBRW Theorem 2 is instead a high-level upper theorem requiring trained nuisance and covariate-law estimators, bounded Gram eigenvalues, basis approximation, and a uniform density-ratio condition, so its full hypothesis package and the present primitive-law package are alternative regimes rather than nested theorem classes. At the law level P_band is a restricted positive-density submodel of KBRW’s broad smooth model where the parametrizations overlap, but KBRW’s low-smoothness hard densities have support holes; hence that converse does not transfer. The standard uniform-design regression submodel does transfer the oracle lower bound.”

TARGET tldr
TARGET interpretation
State the explicit elbow and the two rates. Call the rate “positive-band minimax” only for s≥s_0. Below the elbow call it an attained upper benchmark, not a minimax rate. Qualify any KBRW benchmark comparison outside γ≥β as an algebraic continuation of the objective.

TARGET honest_scope
Replace the sentence denying every positive-band converse by: “The note proves the oracle positive-band lower bound and hence minimax optimality above the elbow. It does not prove a matching positive-band converse below the elbow, because the published low-smoothness hard laws use density support holes excluded by P_band.”

TARGET project_justification.niche
Replace with: “On the explicitly restricted positive-band class and R_pair, close pairs provide the local mass h^{2d}/k needed for an order-one product remainder. Overlap supplies a deterministic population denominator margin, while direct overlap-graph counting controls the diagonal and one-shared-index variance terms of the proved order-one pair kernel.”

TARGET technical_internal_limitation
Replace the extension sentence with: “Any higher-order extension beyond R_pair would require an explicitly specified random-design contrast or localized Möbius estimator together with the corresponding projection or normalization bounds, causal numerator/denominator expansion, exceptional-event control, and complete higher-order collision/Hoeffding accounting. None is asserted here.”

Do not claim that Theorem 1’s low-smoothness converse transfers merely because P_band is a subset of its broad model; lower bounds do not pass from a larger class to an arbitrary subclass.
